name: MARTA Reach
note: 12 named zones (West Atlanta, Kirkwood/Candler Park, County Line, Lakewood, Oakley Industrial, Fulton Industrial, East Point, Hillandale, Candler-McAfee/Belvedere Park, Cedar Grove, Gresham Park, North Fulton) spread across at least Fulton and DeKalb counties with no stated sizes or boundary streets. Checked MARTA fact sheet PDF (itsmarta.com Reach fact sheet) and roughdraftatlanta.com/2026/03/02/marta-reach-on-demand-transit/ - both name the zones but give no square-mileage or street boundaries. No single containing county/city applies across all 12 zones; a human would need MARTA's internal zone-map GIS data to resolve further.

name: Shift On Demand
note: Service area is the ATL Airport Community Improvement Districts (AACIDs), a ~15.7 sq mi district spanning portions of Fulton and Clayton counties, covering portions of the cities of Atlanta, College Park, East Point, Hapeville, South Fulton, and Forest Park - not the full extent of any of these cities. Sources: web.gachamber.com/blog/Government/ATL-Airport-Community-Improvement-Districts-(CIDs)-3120, aacids.com/airport-west-board, shift-atl.com/ondemand/. No CID-specific boundary shapefile found publicly, so the six named cities are used as an approximate proxy.
